introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: OptiCV ("we" or "us" or "our") operates the OptiCV website. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our service and the choices you have associated with that data.

informationCollection.title: 2. Information Collection and Use
informationCollection.intro: We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our service to you.

personalData.title: Personal Data:
personalData.intro: While using our service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you ("Personal Data"). This may include:

cvData.title: CV Data:
cvData.content: When you upload your CV, we store it securely for analysis purposes only.

useOfData.title: 3. Use of Data
useOfData.intro: OptiCV uses the collected data for various purposes:
items: To provide and maintain our service
To notify you about changes to our service
To allow you to participate in interactive features
To gather analysis or valuable information for improvement
To monitor the usage of our service
To detect, prevent and address technical issues
To analyze your CV and profile data using AI services (see section 9)

aiAnalysis.title: 9. AI Analysis and Third-Party Services
aiAnalysis.intro: To provide CV analysis and optimization features, your data is processed by third-party AI services:

deepseek.title: DeepSeek AI Analysis:
deepseek.content: Your CV content and profile information are transmitted to DeepSeek servers for AI-powered analysis and optimization. This includes extracting key information, scoring compatibility, and generating insights. By using our service, you consent to this data transfer. For more information about DeepSeek's data handling practices, please visit their privacy policy at deepseek.com.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection:
dataProtection.content: While we use industry-standard encryption for data transmission, we cannot guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for understanding that uploading your CV involves sharing sensitive information with AI services. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of these third-party services before using our platform.

securityOfData.title: 4. Security of Data
securityOfData.content: The security of your data is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

childrenPrivacy.title: 5. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our service does not address anyone under the age of 18 ("Children"). We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately.

changesPolicy.title: 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesPolicy.content: We may update our privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new privacy policy on this page and updating the "effective date" at the bottom of this policy.

contactUs.title: 7. Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@opticv.com

dataRetention.title: 8. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We will retain your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes set out in this privacy policy. We will retain and use your personal data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations.
